title: Weave a Name Into a Sentence
prompt: Build an f-string that weaves the value of `name` and `rank` straight into the words.

fragments.wrong_hint: Without the leading f, the braces are just literal characters — it would print {name}, not the value. You need the f.
You CAN glue with +, but an f-string is cleaner: drop the name right inside the braces.

config.success: f"{name} the {rank}" — the values woven straight into the sentence.
